description: A list of companies curated by its author, who can let others add to it.

companies.description: Company record keys (domains), in the curator's order.

copiedFrom.description: The list this one was copied from.

open.description: Anyone can add companies: companies suggested for this list (today.joblist.suggestion records) are shown in it at once, credited to who suggested them. Otherwise the author accepts or dismisses each one.

hidden.description: Company record keys suggested by others that the author hid or dismissed.
